bugs_found.title: Bet-logging step never executed for June 10
bugs_found.root_cause: The fetch-slate pipeline produced 8 actionable bets in allEdges but no step wrote them to bets.json. The pipeline was focused on debugging the build_market_ledger.py crash and the bet-write step either (a) depends on marketLedger enrichment that was broken, or (b) does not exist as an explicit pipeline step.
bugs_found.affected_markets: All 8 June 10 actionable recommendations (ML x7, NRFI x1)
bugs_found.impact: Real bets: none placed (confirmed). Paper/model bets: 8 data points lost from CLV sample permanently.
bugs_found.proposed_fix: Add explicit bet-logging step to fetch-slate.yml: 'if any allEdges[actionable==true], append to bets.json with betType/stake/price from allEdges object.' This must be independent of marketLedger enrichment path.

bugs_found.title: NRFI/YRFI signal contradiction in allEdges vs marketLedger
bugs_found.root_cause: For LAD@PIT: allEdges shows NRFI as actionable=True at conf=HIGH stake=$4 (using factor-based nrfi scoring: 83% NRFI). marketLedger shows YRFI as Accepted (using Poisson model: 59.98% YRFI). Two different calculation paths produce opposite signals. The allEdges actionable bet and marketLedger Accepted bet are on opposite sides of the same market.
bugs_found.impact: Model recommended NRFI ($4, HIGH conf) via allEdges but marketLedger found YRFI edge. If the NRFI was 'placed', the model recommended the wrong side by one calculation method.
bugs_found.proposed_fix: Reconcile NRFI/YRFI signal: allEdges must use Poisson-model probability (marketLedger path), not factor scoring. Or: clearly separate the two methods and resolve conflicts with a defined priority rule. The Poisson model should be authoritative per MODEL_CORE.

bugs_found.title: marketLedger Accepted rows missing betType/stake/price enrichment
bugs_found.root_cause: All 35 Accepted rows in marketLedger for June 10 have betType=None, stake=None, price=None. The enrichment that populates these from the allEdges/sizing logic was broken as part of the build_market_ledger.py crash resolution on June 10.
bugs_found.affected_markets: 35 Accepted ledger rows across multiple games and markets
bugs_found.impact: Paper/model bets: none of the 35 ledger-accepted rows were promotable to actionable bets. CLV pipeline received incomplete data.
bugs_found.proposed_fix: Ensure marketLedger enrichment step (betType assignment, stake sizing, price injection) runs independently of the odds None-guard fix. Add validation: any Accepted row must have non-null betType, stake, price before being written.
